statement.p: Find the following integral. Note that you can check your answer by differentiation.

static.solution: w = e^{5 x} + 5. Then dw = 5\,e^{5 x}\,dx, so that \int\,\frac{e^{5 x}}{5 + e^{5 x}}\,dx = {1\over 5}\int\,{1\over w}\,dw = {1\over 5}\,\ln(|w|) + C = {1\over 5}\,\ln(|e^{5 x} + 5|) + C. Because e^{5 x} + 5 is always positive, we can drop the absolute values from the argument of the natural log.
